manual_steps: Pick up an AI mouse and repeatedly transfer it between hands during escape: its five-second attempt should finish. Check a real drop/re-pickup interrupts that old attempt.
Drag a mouse icon under the cursor until escape: stale icon/preview should clear without checkerboard texture or phantom drop. Check a normal item drag too.
Scan healthy, critical and dead mice: verify state, Mouse species and matching visible portrait. Compare Human/Pig; confirm held camera remains smooth.
